instagram_caption:
Jesus, is it wrong that I feel this proud?

He got the thing he worked for and then immediately felt guilty for enjoying it, which is its own kind of exhausting.

The answer was not do not be proud. It was where to put it. "Say thank you more than you say I did it. Lift someone next."

1 Peter 5:5-6 says to clothe yourself with humility and He will lift you up in due time. The lifting is still His. The gratitude is yours.

You are allowed to be glad about this. Just do not carry it alone.
